name: ClojureScript Lein-Figwheel Dev
postCreateCommand: echo '[POST-CREATE] Starting postCreateCommand...' && DATOMIC_VERSION='1.0.7482' && DATOMIC_JAR='lib/com/datomic/datomic-pro/'${DATOMIC_VERSION}'/datomic-pro-'${DATOMIC_VERSION}'.jar' && if [ ! -f "${DATOMIC_JAR}" ]; then echo '[POST-CREATE] Datomic Pro JAR not found, downloading...' && mkdir -p "lib/com/datomic/datomic-pro/${DATOMIC_VERSION}" && curl -L -o /tmp/datomic-pro-${DATOMIC_VERSION}.zip 'https://datomic-pro-downloads.s3.amazonaws.com/'${DATOMIC_VERSION}'/datomic-pro-'${DATOMIC_VERSION}'.zip' && echo '[POST-CREATE] Extracting zip...' && rm -rf /tmp/datomic-extract && unzip -qo /tmp/datomic-pro-${DATOMIC_VERSION}.zip -d /tmp/datomic-extract && echo '[POST-CREATE] Listing extracted contents...' && find /tmp/datomic-extract -type f -name '*.jar' | head -5 && JAR_FILE=$(find /tmp/datomic-extract -type f -name '*.jar' | grep -i datomic | head -1) && if [ -z "${JAR_FILE}" ]; then echo '[POST-CREATE] ERROR: No Datomic JAR found in extracted zip' && find /tmp/datomic-extract -type f | head -20 && exit 1; fi && echo '[POST-CREATE] Found JAR: '${JAR_FILE} && cp "${JAR_FILE}" "${DATOMIC_JAR}" && echo '[POST-CREATE] Verifying JAR placement...' && ls -lh "${DATOMIC_JAR}" && rm -rf /tmp/datomic-pro-${DATOMIC_VERSION}.zip /tmp/datomic-extract && echo '[POST-CREATE] Datomic Pro installed to lib/ (using file:lib repository)'; else echo '[POST-CREATE] Datomic Pro already in lib/' && ls -lh "${DATOMIC_JAR}"; fi && echo '[POST-CREATE] Running lein deps...' && lein deps && echo '[POST-CREATE] lein deps completed successfully' && echo '[POST-CREATE] Verifying Datomic Pro dependency resolution...' && lein classpath | grep -q datomic-pro && echo '[POST-CREATE] Datomic Pro found in classpath' || echo '[POST-CREATE] Datomic Pro not found in classpath'
